race.comment: KALOSYNI (8) has returned in good order this campaign and should be at her top fourth-up. Is still relatively lightly raced compared to the rest and rates a leading chance. DREAMS FULFILLED (6) doesn't win out of turn but has been thereabouts of late, beaten less a length in this grade last start at Murray Bridge. Doesn't need to improve much off that to get the job done this time. ROYAL SCRIPTURE (7) was much better last start at HQ when beaten 0.9L by the in form Justacclaim. Has more to offer though will need a smart steer from a sticky draw. FLYING ACE (4) battled away soundly into second last start at Balaklava behind a dominant winner. Gets weight off with the 2kg claimer going on. In the mix.LAST WAR (18) is mixing his form but boasts peaks that measure up. Not dismissing.
